references.text: The Lord commands Moses to go up on Mount Abarim to see the land that the Israelites will receive, the same command fulfilled in Deuteronomy 34:1.
Describes Mount Nebo in the Abarim mountains opposite Jericho, the same place where Moses ascends in this verse.
Moses is commanded to go up on Mount Pisgah and see the land in all directions, an earlier reference to what happens in Deuteronomy 34:1.
The Lord commands Moses to go up on Mount Nebo in the Abarim mountains in Moab, opposite Jericho, the same action described in this verse.
Gilead is mentioned as a land region, the same area that Moses sees from Mount Nebo.
The tribal territory of Dan in the north is mentioned, the northernmost point Moses sees from Mount Nebo.
Stephen's speech refers to the promise of the land that Moses saw fulfilled from Mount Nebo.
Heroes of faith whom Moses saw the promises of from a distance without receiving them, a parallel to Moses who saw the land but was not allowed to enter.
